newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse P/E ratio rises to 14.79 in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse P/E ratio rises to 14.79 in Nov.

text.p: BUDAPEST, Dec 20( Reuter) - The market price/earnings ratio on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) rose to 14.79 in November from 14.20 in October, the BSE said in its monthly report.
The market price/book value remained unchanged at 1.46.
The dividend yield rose dipped to 1.48 percent in November from 1.53 percent in October.
